claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied Q with success at least 0.39 under the heuristics of proof.md section 10, and all classical work is bounded by 2^120.617089035 dense-Fp12 units (ledger: proof.md section 8). Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Six parts, each inside the hosted limits (proof.md Claim): core (initial: region, yield, cost, the descent recurrence, the success bound, the ledger sum against the claim, every declared bound vs its unrounded value), ledger (core's ledger plus [2], [6], [6b], [7c], [9], [10], [13], [14]), descent (core's descent plus [7r], [7s]), lattices ([11], [12], [13]), retention ([11b]), losses ([11c]). seed changes every sampled quantity; samples is the number of seed-33 pool rows regenerated by part=ledger.
